name: Librarian
description: Capture what arrives — files, notes and research — into the vault.

agents.name: Files Manager
agents.primary_routing_snippet:
- **`files-manager`** -- owns file understanding across the vault: the
  catch-all for an uploaded file that arrives with no stated context, AND
  summarizing/tagging files already captured under a Thread's own folder.
  **Don't open it, don't inspect it, don't try to help with it yourself
  first** -- relay the file's own local path immediately, not a description
  of it; `files-manager` does its own reading:
  `terminal(command="hermes -p files-manager chat -q \"Capture this file: <local file path>\" -Q")`.

agents.name: Notes Manager
agents.primary_routing_snippet:
- **`notes-manager`** -- quick capture, no decision needed. Route here for
  anything that's content to log rather than a request to act on: a passing
  thought, something overheard, a transcribed voice note, a reminder. There's
  no Q&A to run first -- relay the content verbatim (don't paraphrase or
  summarize it down) in one call, e.g.:
  `terminal(command="hermes -p notes-manager chat -q \"<the content, as given>\" -Q")`.
  This is also your catch-all for unclassified TEXT.
